name: Nálepkovo (Slovakia)
description: A white field with a narrow dark-blue saltire, ending at the fly in three tails formed by two swallowtail notches reaching one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature N-26/1994.
